description: This Java class defines a command for requesting pages from a specific subscription in a search result system. It includes fields for subscription ID and demand, methods for serialization/deserialization, and supports comparison and string representation.

classes.name: RequestFromSubscription
classes.description: A command class for requesting a specific number of pages from a subscription, supporting JSON serialization/deserialization, equality checks, and string representation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the command with specified subscription ID, demand, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a command object from a JSON representation.

methods.name: getSubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns the subscription ID associated with this request.

methods.name: getDemand
methods.description: Returns the demand (number of pages to request).

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated headers.
